mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies at Fireman's Park with a temperature of 62 degrees and a waning crescent moon visible.

In city news, a 34-year-old Madison woman was arrested following an investigation into an inappropriate relationship with a student from 2019. Additionally, construction on Highway M enters a new phase this week to accommodate the new Aldi development.
There is plenty to do in Verona. Today, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, the Downtown Farmer's Market kicks off, followed by live music and yoga throughout the area.
The Verona Police Department reported that on Sunday August 30, they received information from the school district that launched an investigation into a sexual assault of a child by a staff member.
For dessert lovers, today's flavor is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. The restaurant is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM.
